agricultural: Agricultural land displays large, regularly gridded patches of uniform crop rows with distinct linear textures and alternating color bands, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white boundary lines of tennis courts, the long wide strips of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways, and the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests.
airplane: An airplane appears as a compact, bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings and fuselage on a uniform gray tarmac surface, distinguishing it from the elongated linear pavement of runways, the regular linear crop row patterns of agricultural fields, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparse residential areas.
baseballdiamond: A baseball diamond features a distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with a diamond-shaped dirt infield and a circular arc boundary, distinguishing it from the large manicured bright green turf with scattered sand bunkers of golf courses, the small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, and the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings.
beach: A beach presents a broad, smooth expanse of fine-grained light tan or white sand with a gentle natural transition to water and subtle wave patterns, distinguishing it from the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation with irregular brownish-green tones of chaparral, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the regularly gridded patches of crop rows with alternating color bands of agricultural fields.
buildings: Buildings appear as clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops, varied shadow patterns, and heterogeneous materials, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing and narrow streets of dense residential areas, the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation of sparse residential areas.
chaparral: Chaparral exhibits a dense, rough, and uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation with irregular brownish-green tones and no organized geometric pattern, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparse residential areas.
denseresidential: Dense residential areas show tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing, narrow streets, and very limited green space between buildings, distinguishing them from the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops and varied shadow patterns of buildings, the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white boundary lines of tennis courts, and the small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure or regular pattern, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows with alternating color bands of agricultural fields, the densely packed small rectangular rooftops of dense residential areas, and the long wide strips of smooth dark gray pavement of freeways.
freeway: A freeway appears as a long, wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings and consistent linear geometry, distinguishing it from the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks.
golfcourse: A golf course features large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered sand bunkers, winding cart paths, and irregularly shaped greens and small water hazards, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows with alternating color bands of agricultural fields, the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparse residential areas.
harbor: A harbor contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, cranes, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, and the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches.
intersection: An intersection displays a clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads with visible lane markings and traffic infrastructure at the junction, distinguishing it from the densely packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks.
mediumresidential: Medium residential areas feature moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards, a regular street grid, and a balanced mix of rooftops and green space, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, and the widely scattered individual houses with large gaps between structures of sparse residential areas.
mobilehomepark: A mobile home park consists of many small, uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows with minimal green space, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white boundary lines of tennis courts, the fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseball diamonds, and the moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards of medium residential areas.
overpass: An overpass appears as an elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road or feature, casting distinct shadows on the surface below, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, and the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral.
parkinglot: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white boundary lines of tennis courts, and the long wide strips of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches, the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral, and the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways.
runway: A runway is a very long, wide, straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement with centralized markings and surrounded by flat open tarmac, distinguishing it from the compact bright metallic cross-shaped object of airplanes, the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, and the elevated linear concrete structure of overpasses.
sparseresidential: Sparse residential areas show widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas, and the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings.
storagetanks: Storage tanks appear as a cluster of perfectly circular, uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures with consistent shadows, distinguishing them from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement of freeways, and the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors.
tenniscourt: A tennis court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with crisp white boundary lines, a central net line, and a uniform colored interior often surrounded by fencing, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, the long wide strips of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways, and the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings.
